title: Implementer guide: E2EE deployment
description: Section on E2EE trade-offs. What breaks when e2eeEnabled is true (recording, livestreaming, gateway participants, live captions). Key exchange is media-layer-defined (Insertable Streams, SFrame). e2eeFingerprint display and out-of-band verification UX. Server trust model (server cannot read media, only routes encrypted frames). When to forbid vs warn on incompatible features.
